english.title: Use / attempt to use / possess more than one driver card on which identified as holder - tachograph cards

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Passenger and Goods Vehicles Recording Equipment Tachograph Card Regulations 2006

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used]_
(B)_[attempted to use]_
(C)_[were in possession of]_

more than one driver card on which you were identified as the holder
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 3(1)(a) and (4) of the Passenger and Goods Vehicles (Recording Equipment) (Tachograph Card) Regulations 2006 and section 2(2) of the European Communities Act 1972.

english.notes:
Regulation 3(3) of the Passenger and Goods Vehicles (Recording Equipment) (Tachograph Card) Regulations 2006 provides a defence. It is not an offence-
(a) to hold a card which will become time-expired within one month and the card which has been issued by the Secretary of State in renewal of the former card; or
(b) to hold a card, which has become time-expired, in combination with another card.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
